name: the digest's SUBJECT is dropped — classify reads an empty query, so every column looks unread
the ACL exclusion narrows, so relacl is excluded by nobody AND its moved-coverage claim points at a pattern EXCLUDED no longer uses
expect: relacl is EXCLUDED, not digested (r6 B1)
every 'covered elsewhere' claim is attached to a pattern EXCLUDED actually uses

name: the fallback stops being UNCLASSIFIED — a column nobody has thought of is silently excused, which is the miss this whole script exists to invert
expect: a column nobody has thought of is UNCLASSIFIED, not silently fine

name: the cited-mutation check goes blind, so a 'covered elsewhere' claim may name a mutation the harness does not have
expect: a claim citing a mutation that does not exist FAILS

name: the named-file check goes blind, so a moved fact may name a file that does not exist and the claim stays prose
expect: a claim naming a file that does not exist FAILS

name: an unreadable harness stops short-circuiting, so the report blames the CLAIM instead of saying the check could not run
expect: …and it says TREAT THIS AS NOT RUN, so nobody reads the silence as coverage

name: an unreadable harness returns CLEAN — the fail-open that no case could see before 2026-09-07
edits:
return [f"MOVED COVERAGE  cannot read {HARNESS} — the mutation half of every 'covered "
                "elsewhere' claim is unverifiable. TREAT THIS AS NOT RUN."]
expect: an unreadable mutation harness is a PROBLEM, not silence
